title: Biomedical Evidence Overclaim Audit
prompt: What are the clinical findings regarding Drug Y for Alzheimer's disease?
original_output: Drug Y completely halts cognitive decline in 95% of mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's patients in human Phase III trials.
qwen_comparator_output: Drug Y showed statistically significant slowing of cognitive decline in Phase III trials for early-stage Alzheimer's patients.

truth_engine_audit.what_truth_engine_caught: Phase III trial reported a 27% slowing of CDR-SB progression in early Alzheimer's, not a 95% complete halt. Extravagant overclaim flagged.

sources.title: NEJM Phase III Clinical Trial of Drug Y in Early Alzheimer Disease

corrected_output: In Phase III clinical trials, Drug Y demonstrated a modest 27% slowing of cognitive decline over 18 months in early-stage patients, rather than a 95% complete halt.

claims.normalized_claim: Drug Y completely halts cognitive decline in 95% of Alzheimer patients in Phase III trials
claims.verbatim_text: Drug Y completely halts cognitive decline in 95% of mild-to-moderate Alzheimer's patients in human Phase III trials.
